questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Please bring me a glass of water.

options.text: Let a glass of water being brought to me, please.
Let a glass of water be brought to me, please.
Let a glass of water come to me.
Let a glass of water be given to me.

questions.solution:
The correct option is **Let a glass of water be brought to me, please.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Given sentence **"****Please bring me a glass of water"** is in **Simple Present Tense** and in **Active voice.**
 
• The sentence given in the above question is an imperative sentence as it refers to a request or command as seen in the given sentence, where the speaker is asking someone to bring a glass of water. 
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Present Tense sentence into a Passive voice is as follows:
 
 
• ​Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence. 
 
• We need to change the verb '**bring'** down to passive, which will become **‘be brought’.**
 
• **Structure (for the sentence that involves requests): **Let + Subject + Third form of verb + Object.
 
• **Example: ** *Sit down, Please. (Active Voice)*
 
 

* Let me be seated. (Passive Voice)*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.

The delegates __talked of __the matter for an hour but without any result.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Talked over."

***__Key Points__**

 
• **"Talked of"** is grammatically incorrect in this sentence. 
 
• The correct usage is **"Talked over"** instead of **"Talked of."**
 
• We use **"*of"** when we want to show that people or things relate to other things or people.
 
 
• ​**Example:** *She was staring at the wall of her office.*
 
 
 
• *​*We use the "over" when describing movement or position that is higher than another and "on something."
 
 
• **Example:** *We were talking over phone. *
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the delegates talked on the matter.

The correct sentence is: **The delegates talked over the matter for an hour but without any result.**

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

As was customary, the young prince was brought to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony.

options.text: As was customary, the young prince brings himself to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony
As was customary, the young prince is bought to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony.
As was customary, the young prince brought in a diamond studded carriage to the podium for the coronation ceremony.
As was customary, the palace staff brought the young prince to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **As was customary, the palace staff brought the young prince to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given sentence **"As was customary, the young prince was brought to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony"** is in **Simple Past Tense **and in **Passive voice**.
 
• The rule for changing a** Simple Past tense** form into an **Active voice** is as follows:
 
 
• ​Interchange the subject with the object and vice-versa. 
 
• Convert the verb into a past participle or 2nd form of the verb.
 
• Structure: **Subject + second form of verb + Object.**
 
 
 
• **Example: ***He drove the car. (Active Voice)*

* The car was driven by him. (Passive Voice)​​*

Therefore, the correct answer is: As was customary, the palace staff brought the young prince to the podium in a diamond studded carriage for the coronation ceremony.

**Additional Information__**

 
• The **Active voice** is used when the subject of the sentence does the action.
 
• The **P****assive voice** is used when we focus on the object of the sentence.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The sharp increase in our consumption of fossil fuels has led to their depletion at an alarming rate.

B. Unchecked burning of fossil fuel is like an unchecked dripping tap which will eventually run dry.

C. The toxic pollutants released from burning these fuels are also a cause for concern.

D. This has led to the tapping of various non-conventional sources of energy that are cleaner alternatives to fossil fuels.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"ACBD"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence A should come first as it is the opening of the paragraph.
 
• Sentence C is the second sentence as it states about toxic pollutants caused by fossil fuels.
 
• Sentence B is the third sentence as it states that unchecking the burning of fossil fuel leads to getting dried.
 
• Sentence D comes at the end as it is the conclusion of the paragraph.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__The paragraph after the re-arrangement is as follows:
 
• The sharp increase in our consumption of fossil fuels has led to their depletion at an alarming rate. The toxic pollutants released from burning these fuels are also a cause for concern. Unchecked burning of fossil fuel is like an unchecked dripping tap which will eventually run dry. This has led to the tapping of various non-conventional sources of energy that are cleaner alternatives to fossil fuels.
